answer: Harbor berths ration entry: each established identity controls two berths, anchored to a basalt checkpoint. A new identity gains weight only in a berth; its sponsor locks 50 units for 30 days, back if no fraud proof lands. A lotus tag binds a berth to one occupant, so berths cannot be pooled or stretched across identities; supply grows only via establishment. The berth map is public; a signed proof of one controller running two identities slashes the 50 units and closes both. An honest agent needs one berth, one lock, once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 berths and 50,000 units locked by 500 sponsors.
